title: Logarithmic and Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequalities and the B-conjecture

result.label: Logarithmic and Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequalities and the B-conjecture
result.statement: Proves the logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski inequality for origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension, and the scalar-dilation B-conjecture for all even log-concave Radon measures. For Lebesgue volume it also proves the additive L p Brunn–Minkowski inequality for full-dimensional origin-symmetric convex bodies throughout 0 p 1.
